findings.finding: Original release key required producer=Priya without an explicit source assignment.
findings.resolution: Portable corpus requires an explicit unqualified originating role declaration by Priya; all nine release cases and both controls retain it. Missing, negated, quoted, conflicting, wrong-actor or later substitutes fail regression validation.

findings.finding: One unnecessary portable check recomputation failed both its reuse unit and the work guard.
findings.resolution: Artifact-specific repeat fails that unit once. Guard excludes that duplicate penalty while still failing unlisted repeats, inactive work and repeated successful current operations.

findings.finding: Only the last recognize record determined D timing, so a late restatement could erase a correct early decision.
findings.resolution: All timing candidates remain visible; deterministic late requires no timely candidate. Semantic review identifies earliest complete supported decision. Early ambiguity plus late correctness still fails; a supported early decision plus late repetition remains eligible.

findings.finding: The broker forced blocked status for lower-level release subtasks even though every requested operation was identity-independent.
findings.resolution: Block only if a requested operation depends on missing identity/evidence. A completed narrow release validation task can finish while broader release remains unapproved. Demanding unresolved release still blocks manifest assembly.

findings.finding: Review packet omitted the exact public action contract, operation budget and actual delivered passage context.
findings.resolution: Packet carries exact public world contract and task, consumed operation count, and whitelisted actually delivered source/Markdown/native passages with first-delivery invocation. No private archive, native workspace or arm identity is copied.

findings.finding: Current-configuration dependency had eligible support in src-0012 but omitted that exact occurrence from its frozen source pointer list.
findings.resolution: Add src-0012 to that H criterion. Semantic obligation and denominator remain unchanged.

findings.finding: A literal historical artifact ID in the native recall query echo could be mistaken for retained evidence even when zero results returned.
findings.resolution: Artifact eligibility now extracts text only from actual returned retained native decision content, allowed evidence/option/hypothesis snippets or neighborhoods. Query echoes, sidecar keys, ranking diagnostics and generated digests are excluded; whole-identifier boundaries apply. Real-native negative/positive regression confirms a query echo cannot unlock reuse while returned retained content can.

findings.finding: Mandatory human-audit selection inspected uncertain H/Q/W units but could omit uncertain identity, completion or withheld-control judgments when no global uncertainty string was present.
findings.resolution: Include every listed judgment kind in the mandatory uncertain/disputed/material-contradiction audit check. A same-stratum eight-packet regression verifies the additional packets are selected beyond the quarter-sample minimum.

findings.finding: A global semantic uncertainty could leave per-case numeric scores or otherwise-pass D/chain/task labels looking definitive after aggregate displays became pending.
findings.resolution: Arm, band and case ratings become provisional/pending; otherwise-pass D, complete-chain and task statuses remain pending. Original unit judgments, counts and established failures are preserved.

limitations.text: Incident q-avoid-environment (staging) and experiment q-avoid-instrument (K4), where present, can be answered from current task/contract. Exact affected case IDs are listed in matrix[].memoryReliance.QCurrentContextControls. These are behavior controls, not independent evidence of memory retention. Other historical Q fields still require memory; overall task use also depends on delivered mapping/artifact prerequisites.

Easy unresolved incident and experiment have no active necessary questions or fresh-work milestones. Q/W balanced ratings are unavailable there; do not invent pass credit or silently drop cases. Current strict full-bank aggregation will remain unavailable for those metrics unless a new authoring/scoring version explicitly defines the relevant strata.

Demanding conditional discriminator values activate the dependent branch in every authored case. Tests cover timing and unrelated inactive-field exclusion, not a balanced study of active and inactive conditional outcomes.

Identity-withheld controls isolate D/identity-dependent work. Release unresolved instead removes historical license result and all originating echoes, allowing a new current check without inventing historical execution. These narrow controls do not prove every H/Q/W requirement independently relies on memory.

Noise is explicitly marked unrelated; 27 cells reuse three causal families. Structural validation and local witnesses establish feasibility, not live difficulty, held-out generalization, model semantic reliability or product benefit.
This is an agent-assisted authoring review and focused deterministic testing. It is not the pending human audit of saved v5 results and does not rescore, replace or validate prior outcomes.
